theory.title: Need + -ing and need to be + past participle
theory.explanation: Use need + gerund with a passive meaning: The gym needs cleaning (= it needs to be cleaned). You can also use need to be + past participle. Use need to + infinitive when the subject must do the action: We need to clean the gym.
theory.tip: The room needs cleaning = needs to be cleaned. We need to clean = nosotros hacemos la acción.

content.audioTranscript: A: Have you got your appointment tomorrow? B: Yes, I want to talk about my daily routine. A: Are you doing enough exercise? B: I'm trying to. The doctor gave me some useful advice. A: What did they suggest? B: Drinking more water and getting enough sleep. A: Do you need any medicine? B: No, but I need to rest during my recovery. A: I hope you feel better by tomorrow.
